units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 76b:3">Ab. Zar. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>והב ליה לבאטי</he> and gave it to B.—

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 76b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>והב ליה למר וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="E00023"><he>הב</he></cite>). Y. Ber. I, 2ᵈ bot. there are people <he>הָבִין וכ׳</he> who pay money for the permission to visit the palace.
